LEMONADE_BACKEND.description: llama.cpp backend for inference. 'cpu' is reliable on Railway's managed containers (no GPU passthrough). Advanced GPU hosts may try 'vulkan'/'rocm'.

LEMONADE_DEFAULT_MODEL.description: Model ID to load on first request (auto-downloaded from HuggingFace). Any Lemonade GGUF model id works, e.g. 'Qwen3-0.6B-GGUF', 'nomic-embed-text-v1-GGUF'. Leave as-is for a tiny default.
